info.title: ATLAS — Data Intelligence Studio
info.description: Local-first data intelligence API. Data never leaves this machine.

Parse the whole staged file, store the canonical table, and profile it.

Discard a staged replacement and restore the previous version unchanged.

otherwise a new derived dataset is created and the source is left untouched.
Download every row matching the filters/search/sort as CSV (paging is ignored).

context.title: Context
context.description: Transcript lines around the evidence (and the evidence itself).

stream_url.title: Stream Url
stream_url.description: Direct audio URL the browser can play (short-lived).

player_url.title: Player Url
player_url.description: The original audio_url (an organizer-hosted player page).

offset_basis.title: Offset Basis
offset_basis.default: Offsets are measured from the first transcript line; the recording may start earlier.

ChartData.title: ChartData
ChartData.description: A chart ready to render. ``rows`` are Recharts-shaped records keyed by ``x`` and series names.

ChecklistImport.title: ChecklistImport
ChecklistImport.description: A checklist as exported by GET /cqa/checklists/{id}/export (or written by hand).

base_version.title: Base Version
base_version.description: The version the edits started from (stale-edit protection).

ChecklistUpdate.title: ChecklistUpdate
ChecklistUpdate.description: Save edits. A changed configuration always becomes a new version; metadata edits do not.

id.title: Id
id.description: Stable key; evaluations and appeals refer to it.

severe_error_rule.title: Severe Error Rule
severe_error_rule.description: What counts as a severe error.

criterion.description: The new criterion. It takes the replaced criterion's position.

model_raw_score.title: Model Raw Score
model_raw_score.description: The evaluator's own score claim. Recorded, never used.

raw_score.title: Raw Score
raw_score.description: Points on the criterion's own scale (binary 0/1, scale value, option points).

normalized.title: Normalized
normalized.description: 0–1 after normalizing to the criterion's scale.

effective_weight.title: Effective Weight
effective_weight.description: Share of the total after N/A redistribution (0–1).

appeals.title: Appeals
appeals.description: Appeal ids for this criterion, newest first.

CriterionView.title: CriterionView
CriterionView.description: Everything the results screen needs for one criterion, original next to final.

conversation_ids.title: Conversation Ids
conversation_ids.description: Explicit conversations. Omit to use the scope below.

group_id.title: Group Id
group_id.description: Scope: only conversations imported with this group.

only_missing.title: Only Missing
only_missing.description: Skip conversations that already have a completed or queued evaluation with this checklist version.

stale.title: Stale
stale.description: The transcript changed after this evaluation ran.

checklist.description: Snapshot of the configuration used, for reproducibility.

raw_output.title: Raw Output
raw_output.description: The evaluator's response, kept for audit.

default.scale: a number on the criterion's scale: min ≤ value ≤ max, on the step grid
default.options: the id of one of the criterion's options

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.default: Every non-N/A result needs at least one evidence reference (message_id, optional verbatim quote) or, when an expected action is missing, an inspected span (start/end message ids) showing which part of the conversation was checked.

not_applicable.title: Not Applicable
not_applicable.default: Set is_na=true with na_reason only when the criterion allows N/A (na_allowed) and its na_rule applies; value must then be null.

severe_error.title: Severe Error
severe_error.default: Set severe_error=true with severe_error_reason only for criteria with severe_error_enabled.

stale.title: Stale
stale.description: The transcript changed after this evaluation ran.

quote_matched.title: Quote Matched
quote_matched.description: True when the evaluator's quote was found in the message.

EvidenceRef.title: EvidenceRef
EvidenceRef.description: A pointer to a real transcript line, with the excerpt taken from the transcript (never from the model).

Filter.title: Filter
Filter.description: A single column condition. ``value`` is a scalar, or a list for ``in``/``not_in``/``between``.

reported_total.title: Reported Total
reported_total.description: total_records as reported by the source.

IngestOptions.title: IngestOptions
IngestOptions.description: Parsing options. ``None`` means "use what detection found".

timestamp.title: Timestamp
timestamp.description: Timestamp exactly as received (MM:SS for chats, ISO 8601 for calls).

offset_seconds.title: Offset Seconds
offset_seconds.description: Seconds from the start of the conversation. Chats: MM:SS. Calls: time since the first line.

at.title: At
at.description: Absolute instant (ISO 8601) when the source gives one.

Message.title: Message
Message.description: One transcript line. ``id`` is stable: ``m{n}`` is the n-th line (1-based) of the source transcript.

mock_results.title: Mock Results
mock_results.description: Latest evaluations produced by the development mock.

QualityFlag.title: QualityFlag
QualityFlag.description: ``basis='detected'`` is a measured fact; ``basis='heuristic'`` is an assumption to verify.

scoring.description: For information only: the backend computes all scores.

audio_url.title: Audio Url
audio_url.description: Recording player page for calls; null for chats.

id.title: Id
id.description: Stable message id (m1, m2, …). Evidence must use these ids.

timestamp.title: Timestamp
timestamp.description: Original timestamp: MM:SS for chats, ISO 8601 for calls.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Optional labels per scale point, keyed by the value as text.

severe_error_policy.title: Severe Error Policy
severe_error_policy.description: flag_only: severe errors are reported next to the score. zero_total: any severe error sets the total to 0. Set it from the official checklist.

na_policy.title: Na Policy
na_policy.description: N/A criteria are removed and their weight is shared proportionally by the applicable ones.

points.title: Points
points.description: The section's contribution to the total (rounded).

SourceMeta.title: SourceMeta
SourceMeta.description: Provenance carried by every computed result (the UI's "source line").

StagedPreview.title: StagedPreview
StagedPreview.description: Returned after upload: what ATLAS detected and how the first rows parse.

TransformStep.title: TransformStep
TransformStep.description: One recipe step. ``op`` selects the operation; the other fields are op-specific.
